kernel.adaptation_note: The exported subset omits unrelated scheduler, x86 and Qualcomm changes from the reference distro. The coordinated follow-up tentatively admits 18 or 20 present CPUs while retaining the existing complete-coverage and firmware hierarchy contracts; only the 20-CPU P16 is physically validated. Use olddefconfig; no full rebuild of this compact subset is claimed.

local_followups.change: Tentative 18/20-CPU coordinated-sleep admission under the same structural firmware gates, with actual CPU count in the boot message; physical validation remains limited to 20 CPUs
Actual admission regression covers 18/20-CPU acceptance with the existing hierarchy and 16/19 rejection; structural and transient-error checks remain required
Byte-identical validated BIOS 305 candidate, renumbered from 1127; accept uniform known parent flags and the exact enabled paired system timing sentinel without rewriting firmware values
Extract actual admission and composition functions; cover BIOS 303/305 profiles, preserved sentinels and malformed-profile rejection

Extract actual system governor and kernel pm_qos/limits constant definitions; test S32_MAX no-constraint sentinel, finite QoS, disabled states and rejection of a mutant without the no-constraint exception
Saturate fallback DRIPS latency addition without rewriting 1125; preserve U32_MAX and finite boundary behavior
Actual setup and selection regression: paired sentinel, near/exact saturation boundary, finite adjustment and unaffected coordinated/non-N1x cases
